verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own data retrieval: the companyCaptable and companyTransactions API operations return a company's cap table and transaction rows in pages. Its marketing also mentions 'custom views and exports' for compliance reports. None of this confirms Excel/CSV export of the complete cap table and full transaction history from the app. missing for 10: explicit Excel/CSV export formats, documented full cap-table and transaction-history file export in the UI, confirmation that export is available at any time and on any plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage

citations.quote: companyTransactions and companyCaptable can return a company's rows in pages, and only the rows that changed since an earlier request.
The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.
One-click equity compliance reports, custom views and exports, make meeting compliance deadlines a breeze.
